formal_statement: (∀ (m n : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin m × Fin m) ℂ)), 3 ≤ m → (∀ i j : Fin n, (A i j).totalDegree ≤ 1) → A.det = ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m), ∏ i : Fin m, (MvPolynomial.X (σ i, i) : MvPolynomial (Fin m × Fin m) ℂ) → (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 - 10 * (m : ℝ) + 11) / 3 ≤ (n : ℝ)) ↔ (∀ m n : ℕ, 3 ≤ m → PEqualNP.Gct.HasDetExpression (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) n → 2 * m ^ 2 + 11 ≤ 3 * n + 10 * m)
plain_statement: Restatement of L-gct-064 by the red team from its plain sentence alone, proved equivalent to the recorded one. Left side: if an n x n matrix of complex polynomials of degree at most 1 in the m^2 variables x_ij has determinant equal to the sum over permutations s of the products x_(s(1),1) ... x_(s(m),m), and m is at least 3, then n is at least (2m^2 - 10m + 11)/3 as real numbers. Right side: the statement of L-gct-064. Guards the definitions of the permanent polynomial and of a determinantal expression, and the natural-number form of the inequality.
title: Red team restatement of the permanent bound (explicit sum over permutations, matrices of affine polynomials, real inequality) is equivalent to L-gct-064
